name: Honda CBR600RR (FSAE) - SDM26 as-built, dyno-calibrated EXPERIMENTAL
_intake_pipes_note: Each runner pipe = runner + head port as ONE pipe (diameter_profile, x from the plenum mouth): 0 m 40 mm -> 0.2481 m 36 mm (head flange) -> 0.3281 m 33 mm (valve seat). The port (80 mm flange->seat, 33 mm = two 23.4 mm valve throats as one pipe) is an ESTIMATE (owner cannot measure); finding 0033 sweeps 50-110 mm. Runners are S-curved, 3D printed (rough): bend loss and wall roughness are not modelled. Injector 79 mm up from the flange (not modelled).
_exhaust_note: Finding 0034: owner-supplied SDM26 as-built 4-2-1, tube sizes are OD with 0.049 in wall (1.25 in -> ID 29.26 mm, 1.5 -> 35.61, 1.75 -> 41.96, 2.0 -> 48.31 mm). Pairing 1&4 / 2&3 (360 deg, unconfirmed from CAD). Each PRIMARY = head port (ESTIMATED 65 mm, 27.65 mm = two 0.85 x 23 mm throats -> 29.26 mm) + 312.3 mm of 1.25 in tube to the first-collector start (last 10 mm steps to 1.5 in) + the 46.6 mm where the two pipes run side by side inside the collector; the junction sits at the merge point. Each SECONDARY = 59.7 mm merged collector cone (area 2 x 1.5 in pipe -> 1.5 in) + 361.0 mm of 1.5 in tube (reading '467.3 mm from the first collector to the end of the second' as first-collector exit to second-collector exit) + 46.6 mm side-by-side in the second collector. The COLLECTOR pipe = 59.7 mm merged cone + ESTIMATED 300 mm straight run / V-band / 90 deg elbow (1.75 in for 100 mm, then 2.0 in; bend loss not modelled) + 12 in (305 mm) straight-through muffler as a plain 2 in pipe (perforation loss not modelled), open end with the 0032 physical reflection + 0.6133 r end correction. Finding 0034 sweeps port 40-90 mm, step/elbow 200-400 mm, 12 vs 17 in muffler and the secondary-length reading.

exhaust_collector.name: exhaust_collector
exhaust_collector.length_note: geometric length; the 0.6133*r Levine-Schwinger end correction is added by physics.exhaust_collector_end_correction

_restrictor_note: 32 mm Bosch butterfly (WOT) upstream of the 36 mm venturi inlet is not modelled (est. <1 % mass-flow effect). The 228 mm venturi is a quasi-steady BC (no neck inertance): its Helmholtz mode with the 1.44 L plenum is ~75 Hz, well below the 4-cyl induction frequency above 4000 rpm.
_plenum_note: Axisymmetric bell loft 38 -> 167 mm, d(t) = 38 + 129 (1 - (1 - t)^1.607) mm over an ESTIMATED 120 mm height (volume held at 1.44 L). Restrictor at x = 0 (top), all four runners at x = L (floor).
description: Finding 0036: the as-built SDM26 (0033 intake, 0034 exhaust) running the car's logged WOT tune (ignition + lambda at the WOT-measured sensor lag), with the momentum-mixing exhaust merge junctions and burned-gas gamma/R (0035), Tempe ambient (97.3 kPa, 305 K), venturi diffuser recovery 0.62 (matches the car's baro-MAP drop within 0.5 kPa) and realistic WOT exhaust wall temperatures (900/750/650 K). Engine level unchanged from the shipped physics (combustion efficiency 0.94, stock FMEP); the only fitted number is a constant drivetrain efficiency 0.94 (wheel/brake), chosen over speed-dependent loss models by cross-validation. No wave knob fitted. Team-dyno RMSE 2.01 kW (6-12.5k), 1.69 kW (7-11.5k).
_tune_note: physics.spark_advance_map = WOT median 'Ignition Angle' (deg BTDC); physics.afr_map = WOT median 'Lambda 1' x 14.7, lambda shifted 270 ms (sensor transport lag, audit hunt/proxy.py filter: APS >= 85 %, no cuts, fuel pressure > 300). Logged pulls end at 10.75k; the maps hold the last value above. Heat release is O2-limited (0032), so rich lambda costs fuel, not the stoichiometric heat.
_calibration_note: drivetrain_efficiency 0.94 fitted (0.938) to the team chassis dyno 6-12.5k; it is an EFFECTIVE wheel/brake ratio that also absorbs any engine-friction (FMEP) error - the dyno cannot separate the two. afr_map = 14.7 x lambda(WOT lag, references/ecu/proxy_wotA.csv).
